summary: Prepaid Expenses (المصروفات المدفوعة مقدماً) new section is fully working end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (4 new prepaid tests + 12 previous OE tests, all green) including CRUD, daily-cost math (1825/365 = 5.0 SAR/day exactly), inclusive period_days, status=expired exclusion, summary.prepaid block with by_type breakdown, /report prepaid_daily/monthly/yearly + prepaid_by_type, dashboard.operating_prepaid_total and net_profit deduction. Frontend: /operating-expenses page now shows 5 tabs (salaries → rentals → prepaid → daily → report) all with correct test-ids. Prepaid tab opens PrepaidPanel; add-prepaid modal exposes type/beneficiary/amount/status/start/end/notes + live preview ('1,825.00 ÷ 365 يوم = 5.00 ر.س / يوم'). Create→Edit→Delete cycle verified: create a vehicle_insurance entry (1825 SAR, 2026-01-01..12-31) → table row shows period_days=365 and daily_cost=5.00 ✓, edit changes amount to 730 → daily_cost recomputes to 2.00 ✓, delete removes row and shows 'تم الحذف' toast ✓. Two summary cards present: oe-card-prepaid-paid (1,825.00 ر.س) and oe-card-prepaid-daily (5.00 ر.س). Report tab oe-report-grid renders the bold 'المدفوعة مقدماً' line + sub-rows for all 6 prepaid types. Dashboard markup contains operating_prepaid_total and the Arabic label.
critical_code_review_comments: expenses_routes.py: prepaid block is clean — PREPAID_TYPES whitelist enforced, _prepaid_period_days uses inclusive math ((end-start).days + 1) which matches the requested contract, _prepaid_active_on properly checks status != 'expired' AND date∈[start,end], and _id is excluded everywhere. Pydantic validators reject invalid expense_type and end<start with 400.
Summary endpoint correctly excludes expired records from both active_count and by_type aggregation — verified by test_prepaid_expired_status_excluded and observed in UI.

Dashboard /api/dashboard.totals correctly exposes operating_prepaid_total and operating_prepaid_by_type; net_profit is reduced by operating_expenses_total which includes prepaid — proven via assert totals['net_profit'] == -totals['operating_expenses_total'] for fresh users with no sales.

Frontend OperatingExpenses.jsx: all new testids exist (oe-tab-prepaid, oe-add-prepaid-btn, oe-prepaid-{type|beneficiary|amount|status|start|end|notes|preview|table|row-{id}}, oe-card-prepaid-{paid|daily}). Live preview computes amount ÷ N days inline using same inclusive logic as the backend. RTL Arabic labels render correctly.
Minor (not blocking): the prepaid row delete uses window.confirm just like salary/rental — consistent with existing app pattern. Toast 'تم الحذف' shows after delete, good UX feedback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (all 5 tabs visible, prepaid CRUD via UI, modal preview, table values, summary cards, report sub-rows, dashboard KPI markup)

Frontend testid contract for prepaid: oe-tab-prepaid (5th of 5 tabs in order salaries/rentals/prepaid/daily/report), oe-add-prepaid-btn, oe-prepaid-table, oe-prepaid-row-{id}, oe-prepaid-{type|beneficiary|amount|status|start|end|notes|preview}, oe-card-prepaid-paid, oe-card-prepaid-daily.
